items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: Johnny Dodds come in with Mac and Mac. Over to this little old theater... We organized our regular bunch.

ctx.x: Royal Garden. And he wants some music, you know. Well, I said, it's a good chance for us to get our old band together. I said, yeah, I'll send for Joe Oliver. Can you get him? I said, sure, I can get him. All right, I'll send for Joe Oliver. That's Joe Oliver. Johnny Dodds come in with Mac and Mac. Over to this little old theater. They had a little old theater there on State Street. It's your big time, you know. He was in there.
Mutt was living for a while too. Mac was there.

I mean, Mutt was there. Yeah. Yeah. I still, I still, uh, may share. And Mutt said, I said, Mutt, I can get you John too. Mutt said, well, I'll go far to St. Louis and I'll jump at St. Louis. He left with St. Louis, but, oh, Bessier just left right away. Well, he played up the deluxe with me. He decided, what's doing? Mutt come back. See? Well, I got Mutt with me. Johnny was very sick, you know. He was sick, you know. I was there. He stayed with me. Then I got Joe. Finally, Nora Dutrae comes through town. He's…
